spans.s:
m. (-दः)
1 Joy, delight, happiness.
2 Fragrance.
E.
मुद to rejoice, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Delighting, rejoicing, causing happiness or delight.
mn. (-कः-कं)
A sort of sweetmeat.
E.
मुद to be glad, in the causal form, to make glad, and ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Delighting, pleasing.
f. (-न्ती)
1 Arabian jasmine.
2 A wild sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
E.
मुद to be pleased, causal form, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pleased, delighted.
n. (-तं)
Pleasure, delight.
E.
मुद to rejoice, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
